purpose: Teach: 和訳/恩給/エクササイズ/クオリア/メディカル/性器/転化/近親

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、英文医療論文の和訳を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be moving forward with English medical paper translation as a team effort.
lines.style: Even, professional opening. Clear and direct without rushing. The tone of someone stating a plan with quiet confidence. Eyes steady on the listener.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、戦傷恩給患者の医療を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we're handling medical care for war pension patients as a coordinated team.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Slight emphasis on 'war pension patients' — acknowledging the weight of the population. Measured pace, warm but clinical in register.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、リハビリエクササイズを医療チームで指導します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be guiding rehabilitation exercises with our team's support.
lines.style: Clear directive, but gentle in delivery. Not commanding — collaborative. Slight nod in the voice. Professional warmth beneath the statement.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者のクオリア体験を医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Yes, we make sure to respect our patients' lived experiences as a team.
lines.style: Measured and deliberate. Weight on 'respect' and 'lived experiences.' The voice of someone who has learned this principle matters. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: メディカルチェック体制を、貴院、強化されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital's really strengthened its medical oversight protocols, hasn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Observant, almost gentle question. Slight hesitation before 'hasn't it' — not presumptuous, genuinely curious. Respectful but engaged. Looking for confirmation of something he's noticed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、性器疾患の検診を医療チームで定期的に行います
lines.en: Yes, we conduct regular screening for genital health conditions as part of our team protocol.
lines.style: Professional and direct. No hedging on the clinical language. Matter-of-fact but not cold. The voice of someone comfortable with the subject because it's necessary care.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、糖尿病のエネルギー転化を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Yes, our team is researching how diabetes affects metabolic energy conversion.
lines.style: Steady explanation. Academic interest evident but grounded in clinical practice. Slight lift on 'metabolic energy conversion' — acknowledging the research dimension. Professional but engaged.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 近親結婚カップルの遺伝相談を、貴院、おこなわれますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital does genetic counseling for couples with family history connections, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful question. Acknowledges sensitivity of the topic. Respectful pause before the question closes. Not invasive — genuinely seeking to understand the hospital's scope. Warm respect in the register.
